name: Democracy
description: Democracy is a unique trick-taking game for 2-6 players where all players simultaneously select and reveal cards. The game features a colonial backstory where players represent powers attempting to annex an island. Cards have special rankings (5-4-3-A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6) and point values, with the goal of capturing majority points in suits to score 'tribes'.

history.cultural: Democracy represents a modern American card game invention with a detailed fictional backstory about colonial powers and island tribes, adding narrative flavor to the mechanics.
history.evolution: The game has maintained its unique simultaneous play mechanic and colonial backstory. Related games include GOPS (Game of Pure Strategy) which shares the simultaneous reveal mechanic.

setup.players:
Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 3-5
Partnerships: None - individual play
setup.deck:
Type: Modified standard deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Added for 4 players (2 jokers), 6 players (1 joker)
Card removal: All twos removed (48 cards base)
Special ranking: 5-4-3-A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6 (high to low)
setup.dealing:
Cards dealt face down clockwise
Extra 'voting pool' hand dealt to center
Two-day structure: half deck each day (or play variations)
Example: 4 players = 5 cards each + 5 in pool per day
setup.equipment:
Standard 52-card deck
Score sheet for tracking tribes
Table space for voting pool

rules.objective: Collect majority of points in suits to score 'tribes' (game points). First player to reach agreed number of tribes (usually 5, 7, or 10) wins the match.
rules.gameplay:
1. Dealer flips card from voting pool to determine trump suit
2. Each player selects one card from hand and places it face down
3. On dealer's signal, all simultaneously reveal cards
4. If trumps played: highest trump wins (except 6 beats 5 of trumps if both played)
5. If no trumps: highest card wins regardless of suit
6. Winner takes all played cards and voting card
7. In case of tie for highest (no trumps): each takes own card, voting card discarded
8. Jokers can represent any non-trump card
9. Continue until all cards played, then score
keyRules: All players select and reveal cards simultaneously
No requirement to follow suit or play trump
Special rule: 6 of trumps beats 5 of trumps if both played
Jokers represent any non-trump card (lose to any trump)
Tie for highest (no trumps): each player keeps own card only
Game played in two 'days' with half the deck each

strategy.basic:
Learn the unusual card ranking (5-4-3-A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6)
Track which high-value cards have been played
Aim to capture cards in suits where you already have points
Use jokers strategically when available
strategy.intermediate:
Count cards to estimate opponent holdings
Predict what suits opponents are collecting
Time your high cards to win crucial tricks
Balance capturing cards across multiple suits
strategy.advanced:
Bluff and misdirection in card selection
Read opponents' patterns across multiple games
Calculate probabilities of trump being played
Optimize play for suit sweep bonuses if using that variation
tips: Watch for opportunities to play when no trump is likely
Remember that 6 beats 5 of trumps - a key exception
Track which players are collecting which suits
Consider the two-day structure when planning your strategy
Bad catch rule: if dealt only 1-point cards in first day, can call misdeal and score 1 tribe

variations.name: Days
variations.description: Play the whole game as a single day, or divide into more than two days; more days means less choice and more luck.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Optional deal structure; no engine constant overrides needed for this variant.

variations.name: Bad Catch
variations.description: Player dealt only one-point cards in first day may call misdeal and score one tribe automatically.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Optional rule; engine would need misdeal detection and auto-score logic.

variations.name: High Stake
variations.description: Bad-catch player may elect high stake; suits they win score 2 (or 3) tribes instead of 1.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Optional scoring multiplier; would require variant-specific scoring overrides.

variations.name: Ghost / Klepto
variations.description: When joker is voting card, each player draws one card from neighbour's hand and captures it; joker discarded.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Optional joker rule; would need custom phase or action for card swap.

variations.name: Dummy Joker
variations.description: Joker worth zero, ranks below 6, always loses; no suit.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Joker behaviour change; would need rank or special-card overrides.

variations.name: Suit Sweep
variations.description: Player capturing all 12 cards of a suit scores two tribes; some require announcing sweep before first vote.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Optional bonus scoring; would need scoring or constant overrides.

scoring.description: Players earn tribe points by capturing majority point value in suits over the hand/day.
scoring.winCondition: First player to the agreed tribe total wins the match.

synthesis.shortDescription: A simultaneous-play trick game where players reveal one card at once and score by controlling suit points.
